title: What is Sociology?
content: Sociology is the study of society, social relationships, and social institutions. It examines patterns of social behavior and the forces that shape them.

title: Social Welfare (summary)
content: Welfare refers to the general state of health, well-being and happiness in a society. Approaches include universal, means-tested, and solidaristic welfare systems.

title: Positivism vs Interpretivism
content: Positivism argues sociology should use methods like the natural sciences. Interpretivism (Verstehen) emphasizes understanding social action from the actor's perspective.

title: Functionalism (key points)
content: Functionalism focuses on social structures that maintain stability and cohesion; critics say it underplays conflict and social change.
